_comment: Event confirmed via web search: RVYC Salish Sea Regatta, Sept 11-13 2026, three stages totalling ~85 nm. royalvan.com/salish-sea is blocked by this environment's network egress policy, so the entry list, per-stage distances and scoring method below are still UNCONFIRMED.
EVERY NUMBER BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER so the tool runs out of the box.
Replace with the class scratch sheet / ORC certificates before racing:
tod  = allowance in seconds per nautical mile (lower = faster boat),
keyed by the band the RC scores under.
tot  = time-on-time multiplier (higher = faster boat); ORC publishes
675/GPH as the single number plus Triple Number low/med/high.
Each race needs: scoring (ToD or ToT), the band to use, and either
distance_nm (ToD) or reference_elapsed (ToT, the assumed elapsed time
of the boat being owed; omit it for a per-hour table).
